title: Odd majority total influence error
statement: For each nonnegative integer $m$, define the odd-majority total influence error to be the total influence of majority on $2m+1$ coordinates, viewed as a real number, minus $\sqrt{2/\pi}\,\sqrt{2m+1}$.
